assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone Windows EXE application icon for Network Recovery, a Windows automatic network repair utility. Primary request: create ONE polished, distinctive, extremely readable icon: a solid rounded shield in the app's existing vivid royal-blue palette (#2563EB), with a bold white Wi-Fi symbol centered inside, made of two thick curved bands and one round dot. A subtle circular recovery arrow integrated into the lower-right edge of the shield communicates automatic reconnection, but keep the silhouette simple and bold. Front view, symmetric shield, centered on a square canvas, icon fills roughly 82% of the canvas with ample transparent margin, clean precise contours. Style: premium modern Windows desktop application icon, mostly flat solid colors, very restrained blue shading, strong contrast, legible at 16 and 32 pixels; no hairline strokes, tiny ornament, gloss, busy textures, perspective, or long shadows. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, not white or checkerboard. No text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, mockup, frame, or additional icons. The output must be a single isolated icon asset, not a presentation sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied blue Network Recovery application icon. Produce its ENABLED/MONITORING ON system-tray variant as ONE isolated icon. Keep exactly the same shield silhouette, size, placement, white Wi-Fi symbol, front view, square canvas, and transparent alpha background. Change only the blue shield fill to a strong emerald green (#16A34A) with the same very restrained shading. Replace only the lower-right circular recovery-arrow symbol with a bold white check mark in approximately the same footprint, harmoniously integrated with the shield; use a clean simple check, thick enough to read at 16 and 32 pixels. Preserve the geometric family and alignment of the original icon. White Wi-Fi + green shield + white check must clearly communicate monitoring enabled. No text, captions, letters, new background, checkerboard pixels, shadows outside the icon, mockup, or extra icons. Actual transparent background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied blue Network Recovery application icon. Produce its DISABLED / MONITORING OFF system-tray variant as ONE isolated icon. Keep exactly the same shield silhouette, size, placement, white Wi-Fi symbol, front view, square canvas, and genuinely transparent alpha background. Change only the blue shield fill to a neutral slate gray (#64748B) with the same very restrained shading. Replace only the lower-right circular recovery arrow with a bold white pause symbol, two thick parallel vertical bars with rounded ends, in approximately the same lower-right footprint. Keep the bars neatly separated from the Wi-Fi dot. Preserve the geometric family, scale and alignment of the original icon. White Wi-Fi + gray shield + white pause bars must clearly communicate monitoring disabled rather than a lost network connection. Strong simple shapes legible at 16 and 32 pixels. No text, captions, letters, new background, checkerboard pixels, shadows outside the icon, mockup, or extra icons. Preserve actual transparency.
